name: pdfvera
description: Convert PDF invoices into XRechnung and ZUGFeRD e-invoices, and Brazilian bank statement PDFs into OFX, CSV and Excel, right from Claude. Reads the PDF from your computer and writes the results next to it. Needs a pdfvera plan and an API key.

api_key.title: pdfvera API key
api_key.description: Create it in your pdfvera account: pdfvera.com/de/konto/ or pdfvera.com/pt-br/conta/
